main.description: A §1.16 social-security IN-KIND funding proposal for a lifeline-commons cell (ADR-2606272100). Funded on the non-profit rails: donation → TitheRouter 10% → Public Fund → grant/milestone-escrow/in-kind. Delivery is §1.16 in-kind: cash ≡ 0 to the consumer (G2) — a lifeline is a commons right, never billed, never disconnected for non-payment. iriai is a STEWARD, not a sovereign (G3): every proposal is advisory; the Public Fund (1 SBT = 1 vote) decides. The subaru 昴 in-kind precedent + Displacement-Dividend coupling.

instrument.description: G2 — give-only instrument algebra; equity/debt/revenue-share/subscription unrepresentable

imputedAnnualUsd.description: market-equivalent annual worth of the in-kind delivery (aggregate, transparency-only) — proves the §1.16 income is HIGH while cash ≡ 0. NOT a price, NOT a bill.

reachPop.description: people the delivery reaches (provision reaches served + gap; aggregate, G1)

fundingSource.description: G4 — non-profit rails only (USDC/Base/ERC-4337 or non-custodial fiat→USDC)

cashToConsumer.description: G2 — cash ≡ 0; the consumer is never billed

displacementDividendCoupled.description: build/ops labour freed by OSS robotics funds a tenure-weighted in-kind cohort pool (ADR-2606032130)

advisory.description: G3 — iriai proposes; it does not decide

bindsFund.description: G3 — the Public Fund (1 SBT = 1 vote) decides, not iriai
